subject: Or
author: Flamechu
body: Try loading any EA game. It will connect to the sever, then back out to the dash and load up the demo.

subject: It sometimes goes a bit funny...
author: SUFFUR
body:
And you have to go back to the dash board, and restart it, drive around for a bit, and jump on  random game to test the connection, well thats what I do, or go to the News, and see if you can connect that way? Its sometimes tempermental, but after 6 to 7 trys I go to bed or play something else?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
